project.title: Study of Three Typical Nutritional Denitrification Types
project.description: Nitrogen plays an important role in nature and biological processes. However, excessive discharge of nitrogen-containing wastewater seriously threatens the stability of ecosystems and public health and safety. This study looks at the nitrogen removal characteristics of three typical nutrient-type denitrification processes (autotrophic, heterotrophic, and mixotrophic) and explores their underlying mechanisms.
